engine.name: Elektron Digitone
engine.description: Elektron Digitone FM synthesizer: every parameter of its manual's MIDI appendix, as the controllers and NRPNs it prints, on the track and FX channels.

sources.title: Digitone User Manual, OS 1.44

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/elektron/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/elektron/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI appendix, with its printed name, sent on the CC it prints (a 14-bit pair where it prints an LSB), or its NRPN where it prints no CC. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The appendix prints no ranges: each parameter takes what its controller carries, 0 - 127 (0 - 16383 for a pair). What a value shows, and the values of a setting chosen from a list, are in the parameter's chapter of the manual.
The channel variable is a track's channel (track 1's by default): the parameters go to that track. Set it to the AUTO channel to edit whichever track is active.

Printed twice on the same controller and channel, laid out once: MASTER Chorus Send L/R (the same as MASTER Chorus Send L), MASTER Delay Send L/R (the same as MASTER Delay Send L), MASTER Reverb Send L/R (the same as MASTER Reverb Send L), MASTER Master Overdrive (the same as MASTER Master Overdrive).

The appendix gives one controller to more than one parameter; each is sent as printed, but when the instrument sends it CEditor follows neither: CC 13 on the channel variable's channel: Trig Filter Trig, Amp Delay Send; CC 14 on the channel variable's channel: Trig LFO Trig, Amp Reverb Send; CC 16 on the channel variable's channel: Trig Portamento On, Syn1 Ratio B.
Left out, the wheels, pedals and breath controller, which set nothing of the sound: MISC Sustain, MISC Sostenuto.
The fxChannel variable is 16 here: the manual prints no default for it; set it to the instrument's FX CHANNEL (SETTINGS > MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS) setting.
The midiChannel variable is 9 here: the manual prints no default for it; set it to the instrument's MIDI 1–4 CHANNEL (SETTINGS > MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS), a MIDI track's, setting.
An NRPN-only parameter is sent as its number (MSB on CC 99, LSB on CC 98) and a 7-bit value on data entry (CC 6), which the appendix does not spell out; not checked against the instrument.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same controllers (or NRPNs, as its PARAM OUTPUT setting says) when its knobs are turned
